editorial.headline: Rachaad White Gets TD; Jacory Croskey-Merritt Leads Playing Time
editorial.thread_title: [WAS] Rachaad White Gets TD; Jacory Croskey-Merritt Leads Playing Time

evidence.feed_summary: Commanders RB Rachaad White notched the backfield's only TD in Sunday's win over the Seahawks, taking a reception in from 6 yards out in the first quarter. That marked his only target for the game, and White added a mere 35 rushing yards on 8 carries. He left briefly with a shoulder injury but returned. RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt, meanwhile, logged 18 carries and 1 catch (on 1 target), while beating White 39-30 in total snaps and 17-14 in pass routes.
evidence.original_title: Rachaad White Gets TD; Jacory Croskey-Merritt Leads Playing Time

editorial.headline: Michael Wilson Sees 17 Targets and Pushes Into WR1 Range
editorial.thread_title: [ARI] Michael Wilson Sees 17 Targets and Pushes Into WR1 Range

evidence.feed_summary: Wilson finished the Cardinals’ Week 3 loss with a team-high 17 targets. He hauled in 11 of his 17 targets for 89 yards and a TD. The Cardinals WR ranks as a WR1 for the first time this season pending Sunday- and Monday Night Football.

editorial.headline: Jaylen Waddle: Quiet twice through three games
editorial.thread_title: [DEN] Jaylen Waddle: Quiet twice through three games

evidence.feed_summary: Waddle caught two of seven targets for 10 yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams. He also rushed once for 14 yards and caught a two-point conversion. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
